sources.name: Inspired Taste favorite-pasta-shape survey (also via Mental Floss / Fox News)
sources.method: Self-reported survey of 1,007 US adults on favorite shape (2025, page updated Nov 2025). Favorites: Spaghetti 26%, Penne 25%, Fettuccine 15%, Elbows 14%, Bowties 14%. Orzo and angel hair named least favorite (18%). Mental Floss state map from the same release: spaghetti won 20 states, fettuccine 5, rotini 3 (SD, MO, AK), angel hair 2, linguine 1 (NE), rigatoni 1 (IL). Used positions 1-5 (missing = 10).

sources.name: Barilla National Spaghetti Day survey (via Yahoo/Tasting Table)
sources.method: Barilla US consumer survey, late 2024 (article Jan 2026): top shapes Spaghetti, Angel Hair, Penne, then Fettuccine and Lasagna; North leans to tubes (ziti, rigatoni, penne). No percentages or sample size on page. Used positions 1-5 (missing = 10).

sources.name: YouGov Ratings - Italian dishes, popularity (US adults), mapped to shape
sources.method: % of US adults with a positive opinion, Q3 2026 (read from the public-data API the page loads, group 1d140911-cb6c-11ea-8c61-fbfac8b333d9; only 20 dishes in group, same pasta items in the all-dishes group). Pasta dishes mapped to their shape: Lasagna 82, Spaghetti with meatballs 81, Ravioli 78, Macaroni and cheese 77, Fettuccine Alfredo 75, Angel Hair Pasta with Shrimp 67, Tortelloni 66, Stuffed Manicotti 64, Baked Ziti 63, Pasta with Vodka Sauce 57 (mapped to Penne). Shape positions 1-10 (missing = 15). Dish-level, so it measures liking of the dish, not the shape.

sources.name: Google Trends US search interest per shape, past 12 months (Oct 2025-Oct 2026)
sources.method: Average US search interest over 12 months, chained in 5-term comparisons anchored on 'rigatoni' (=1.00); read from the Trends explore/multiline API on 2026-10-12. Terms combined spellings/common names (e.g. 'farfalle + bow tie pasta + bowtie pasta + bow ties', 'angel hair + capellini', 'macaroni + elbow pasta + elbow macaroni', 'stuffed shells + pasta shells + shell pasta + conchiglie', 'spaghetti -squash'). Relative values: Spaghetti 7.9, Lasagna 5.1, Macaroni 2.25, Gnocchi 1.88, Orzo 1.76, Ravioli 1.56, Tortellini 1.42, Penne 1.26, Fettuccine 1.07, Rigatoni 1.00, Ziti 1.00, Linguine 0.71, Angel hair 0.63, Shells 0.62, Bucatini 0.53, Farfalle 0.44, Tagliatelle 0.35, Manicotti 0.35, Pappardelle 0.33, Rotini 0.29, Cavatappi 0.29, Fusilli 0.25, Cavatelli 0.19, Orecchiette 0.16, Ditalini 0.16, Cannelloni 0.15, Mostaccioli 0.13, Campanelle 0.08, Rotelle 0.06, Gemelli 0.04 (egg noodles 0.72 and vermicelli 0.39 excluded: mostly non-Italian noodle searches). Search volume over-weights shapes people look up recipes or definitions for (gnocchi, orzo) and under-weights shapes with many names (bow ties).

changes_vs_current: Positions 12-24 now all have data (Google Trends ranks every shape; YouGov dish ratings cover Manicotti). Mechanical order: Spaghetti 1.25, Lasagna 4.5, Fettuccine/Macaroni 5.25, Penne 5.75, Ravioli 7.25, Angel Hair 7.75, Tortellini 8.5, Gnocchi 9.75, Ziti/Orzo 10, Rigatoni 11.25, Farfalle/Manicotti 11.5, Linguine 11.75, Shells 12.25, Bucatini 12.5... Changes vs current list: Penne 5->2 (#2 and #3 in the two shape-level polls; low only in the dish-mapped YouGov and in raw search); Lasagna 3 stays; Macaroni 4 stays; Fettuccine 2->5 (behind the three above in the average and in search interest); Ravioli 7->6; Farfalle 10->7 (gut-check move: tied 4th favorite at 14% in Inspired Taste; its low search figure comes from people searching it under several names); Angel Hair 6->8; Tortellini 9 stays; Ziti 8->10; Rigatoni 12->11 and Linguine 13->12 (gut check; Trends has them #10 and #12 among shapes); Gnocchi 18->13 and Orzo 21->14 (Trends #4 and #5, but no poll names them as favorites, Orzo is a top 'least favorite', and with one source each they cannot sit in the top 10); Manicotti 11->15 (YouGov dish 64% but only 18th in search); Shells 22->16 (Trends #14; gut-check pick); Rotini 14->17 (Trends #20 but won 3 states in Inspired Taste and is a gut-check pick, so moved above the remaining one-source shapes); Bucatini 15->18, Tagliatelle 23->19, Pappardelle 17->20, Cavatappi 20->21, Fusilli 19->22, Cavatelli 24->23, Orecchiette 16->24, all in Trends order. Orecchiette (0.163) and Ditalini (0.162) are effectively tied for #24; kept the incumbent. Aliases added: spirals (Rotini), corkscrew/cellentani (Cavatappi), cannelloni (Manicotti, usually the same tube in US stores), stuffed/jumbo shells, common misspellings.
confidence: medium. Top 10 each have 2-4 people sources and match the gut check, but the shape-level polls (Inspired Taste, Barilla) only publish top 5s, YouGov is dish-level, and Google Trends is the only source for positions 11-24. Search volume over-weights shapes people look up (gnocchi, orzo) and under-weights shapes with several names (bow ties, shells). No public US retail sales by shape (Circana/NielsenIQ/NPA) and no YouGov, Talker or Instacart shape poll was found. Wikipedia pageviews were tried but are global and were rate-limited, so they are not used.
